title: Exact all-h shared ORIGINAL line D6 cycle-gluing probability polynomial
statement: For each h>=1 and genuine original W(3,s), s=2^h, with minimal unordered physical-pair alphabet a, K=binom(a,2), any ONE fixed complete globally injected original source point map f and any two TRUE eligible distinct-six-original-incidence Q0,Q1 each having six distinct original point and line factors and a connected physical left C6, let r be the number of common ORIGINAL line source IDs (0<=r<=6), and tau their CANONICAL joint cyclic original-line-support signature. Under ONE uniformly sampled complete globally injected source line map g shared by both Q, E_g[1_D6(Q0,g) * 1_D6(Q1,g) | f,Q0,Q1]=((a)_6/(K)_(12-r))*sum_{k=0}^6 c_(tau,k)*(a-6)_k, where c_(tau,k) counts valid canonical second-cycle physical coordinate assignments with k new colors, exact shared original line pair-label equality and global injection. Coefficients are nonnegative integers. The joint probability depends on tau, not merely r. For r=6 identical cyclic adjacency the two events coincide; for r=6 different adjacency the joint probability is zero.

quantifiers.domain: any fixed COMPLETE globally injected original point physical-pair map shared by all candidate Q
two eligible actual six-distinct-original-incidence Q with six distinct original point and six distinct original line factors per Q and fixed physical-left connected C6
ONE uniformly random COMPLETE globally injected original source line physical-pair map, shared across BOTH original Q and all other candidates

external_dependencies: Predecessor scientific PR #485 disjoint original-line-factor pair kernel, historical 64-term H_a complement count; not newly proved by this import.
Original AA4-U-CYC scientific source PR #487 canonical 13,327-pattern coefficient enumeration and original source-line cycle-signature normalization.
Physical D6 original-column aligned GF5 positional classifier from AA4-Q and exact globally injective marginal assignment distribution.
limitations: The identity is a pair probability for two selected original Q under uniform complete g, NOT a nonzero lower bound for each individual fixed globally injected pair f,g.
The joint pair kernel does NOT by itself provide a complete conditional second moment, variance, concentration estimate, or universal root Branch A/B/C proof.
Line-overlap cardinality r alone does not determine the joint D6 probability; original relative cycle position tau matters.
Some tau have probability exactly zero despite a positive one-event D6 conditional mean.
falsification_boundary: Reject per-Q independently sampled right physical labels, shared coordinate-only overlaps without SAME ORIGINAL line source IDs, reused labels for distinct source lines, nonoriginal sixsets, and physical path surrogates.
